title: Syrian Zesty Kebabs
description: A flavorful vegetarian kebab recipe with the perfect blend of zesty and syrian spices.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high temperature.
Soak the zesty bread in water for 5 minutes, then cut into 1-inch cubes.
In a large bowl, combine the kebab meat substitute and 1 tsp of kebabs spices.
Add the thinly sliced onion to the bowl and mix well.
Thread the kebab meat mixture onto the zesty bread cubes.
Brush the kebabs with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Serve hot and garnish with fresh parsley.
